headline: No scored news; lines drift as stories fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Earlier stories faded slightly, trimming Enslaved God, Protector God and Descendants by a few hundredths. With no fresh news, the board still reflects this week's GPT-5.6 launch and chip-industry results. Horizon Balance held at +1.77.
